document.title: KCXDocumentor Prototype User Guide
document.summary: This sample guide demonstrates local DOCX rendering from a compact guide draft without external AI processing.

audience: Implementation consultants validating generated guide structure
prerequisites: Access to the target Windows application
A completed recording-derived guide draft or procedure trace
workflow_overview: Follow the extracted procedure steps in order.
Confirm expected results and review notes before publishing.
expected_results: The user can complete the documented workflow without watching the original recording.
Reviewers can trace each procedure step back to timing and visible UI context.
troubleshooting: If a screenshot is missing, rerun frame selection or attach a reviewed still image to the step.
If a UI label is incorrect, correct the guide draft before publishing.
review_notes: Prototype output should be reviewed before customer distribution.

steps.title: Open the customer workflow
steps.action: Select the customer workflow from the application navigation.
steps.expected_result: The customer workspace opens and displays the available actions.

steps.title: Create the customer record
steps.action: Click New Customer, enter the required account details, and save the record.
steps.expected_result: The application saves the customer record and displays a confirmation or updated customer detail screen.
notes: Use approved sample data when producing customer-facing documentation.
